title: Episode Cluster Reports: one dashboard for podcast network performance across platforms
summary: A short product announcement for Listener.com's Episode Cluster Reports, a centralized dashboard for teams managing multiple podcasts or a network. It frames the problem as not being able to answer "how's this episode doing?" and lists the features. Little durable strategic insight beyond the product pitch.

principles.text: Build the product around the one question customers keep asking and can't answer clearly.
principles.quote: "How’s this episode doing?" If you manage multiple podcasts or run a network, you’ve probably asked this—and struggled to get a clear answer.

principles.text: Centralize cross-show, cross-platform performance data into one view so teams see what's working, where, and why.
principles.quote: It gives your team a centralized view of what’s working, where, and why across every show and platform.

principles.text: Pair a live reporting dashboard with a short demo to sell a new feature.
principles.quote: Here’s a 3-minute demo showcasing the power of this new feature.
